reason: A DSH Web GUI theme plugin focused on visual customization, with configurable media backgrounds, animated visual effects, LLM activity indicators, and optional OpenCode Go quota display using user-provided credentials.

summaries.zh: 为 DSH Web GUI 提供受《云图计划》风格启发的可配置视觉主题、动态背景、LLM 活跃度指示和可选 OpenCode Go 配额显示。
summaries.en: A configurable DSH Web GUI theme inspired by Neural Cloud, featuring animated backgrounds, LLM activity indicators, and optional OpenCode Go quota display.

capabilities: Injects CSS and JavaScript into the DSH Web GUI
Renders configurable video, image, contour-line, and Conway's Game of Life backgrounds
Reads session and event activity to calculate an LLM activity score
Reads and writes local configuration including cookie, workspace ID, limits, and visual settings
Sends configured cookie data to opencode.ai to retrieve quota information
Provides local endpoints for quota data, activity data, and custom media upload and retrieval
